NOW ACCEPTING NEW CLIENTS

A little bubbly. A lot of care.

Soft silhouettes, generous space and a confident grid. Candy colors carry the personality; deep cocoa keeps every message clear. Real grooming photos will sit alongside an original illustrated spa pup.

01 / Typography

Fredoka + Nunito

Fredoka 500–600 for friendly headings. Nunito 400–800 for readable body text and controls.

Actual Fredoka and Nunito specimens are embedded in this approval board. The app will load them through next/font.

02 / Shape

Fluffy, not fussy.

24px cards, 32px panels, pill buttons, tinted shadows. A 4px spacing rhythm keeps everything tidy.

03 / Mascot

Your spa-day buddy.

A cream-colored pup with floppy ears, an aqua towel and a bubble crown. Separate ears, tail, eyes, body and waving paw are ready for animation.

NIGHT-TIME BATH

Same joy. Softer lights.

Deep navy-purple #201C32, vanilla text and unchanged candy accents. Buttons retain cocoa text. Dark-mode surfaces: #302943; borders: #BAA8D2.

Book a Spa Day ↗

Color tokens & measured contrast

Original brand colors preserved. Grape is decorative only: cocoa on grape does not meet normal-text AA. Focus rings use darker berry #AA245C; outlines use #876D78 for visible boundaries. Contrast values use the WCAG sRGB formula.

Motion plan

Hero: waving paw, blinking eyes, wagging tail and drifting bubbles. Cards: spring lift and gentle icon wiggle. Sections: small staggered reveals. Gallery: keyboard-operable comparison handle. Reviews: manual navigation. Booking: pending brush animation and success-only celebration after confirmed delivery. All loops pause off-screen and stop for reduced motion; text stays visible without JavaScript.

Approved direction

Palette, typography and mascot approved by the user on October 14, 2026 (Asia/Manila). Website implementation is included in this package.
